teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers are 6-0 and the top-ranked team, with an offense worth +3.9 points. The model also rates them 3.3 points higher than the betting market does. Next up is a trip to Atlanta in week 7.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo slips to #2 after a 33-30 win at Las Vegas that was closer than the model liked. The offense is +4.8 points, but the defense is -1.2 points. The Ravens visit in week 8.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville climbs to #3 despite a 34-31 loss to the Texans. The offense (+1.9 points) carries them, and the model has them favored by 7.5 over the Colts in week 8.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams are 2-4 yet still rated #4, mostly on an offense worth +2.3 points. An 18-16 home loss to the Cardinals cost them a spot. The strength of record rank is 23.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City is 5-0 and won 5 straight, the latest a 22-6 win over the Chargers. Up next is a road game at Seattle, where the model has them as underdogs by 1.4.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit used the bye week to hold at #6 on the strength of a +2.9 point offense. The Packers visit in week 7, and the model has the Lions favored by 4.9.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle stays at #7 after a 17-14 loss at Denver. Drew Lock's start puts them 1.8 points below their usual quarterback situation, but the model still likes them by 1.4 over the Chiefs.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago jumps two spots to #8 after a 31-23 win in Atlanta. Their rating rose 2.2 points, with injuries accounting for +1.4 points. The Patriots visit next.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England has won 3 straight and holds at #9 after beating the Jets 26-19. Next is a trip to Chicago, where the model has them as underdogs by 2.6.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota is 5-0 and still falls two spots to No. 10 after a bye week. The model sees a defense at +2.5 points and an offense at -1.8 points.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay has won 3 straight, the latest a 23-13 win over Dallas, and rises to No. 11. The Lions are next, and the model has the Packers as 4.9-point underdogs.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston makes the biggest jump of the top half, up 5 spots to #12 after a 34-31 win at Jacksonville. The record is still 2-4, but the Giants come to town in week 7.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati fell two spots to #13 without playing, thanks to the bye week. At 3-2 they face Baltimore next, and the model has them favored by just 0.3.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver is 4-2 despite a point differential of -11. The 17-14 win over Seattle moved them up a spot to #14, and the defense is the strength at +1.3 points.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina rises 3 spots to #15 after a 25-14 win over the Eagles. The Panthers are 3-2 with a 64 percent chance to win the division, and Tampa Bay visits next.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis drops 3 spots to #16 after a 26-20 home loss to the Titans, who are ranked #32. At 2-4, their playoff odds are 21 percent.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta drops three spots to No. 17 after a 31-23 home loss to the Bears. The offense at -1.6 points is the problem, and the 49ers are next.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh is 4-2 after a 26-19 win at Tampa Bay, and moves up to #18. The offense is the weak spot at -0.9 points. Next is a neutral-field game against the Saints.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas falls 3 spots to #19 after a 23-13 loss in Green Bay. The defense is -2.2 points, and the model rates them 3.9 points lower than the betting market does.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington holds at #20 after a 23-17 loss to the top-ranked 49ers. The record is 1-4-1, but the model has them favored by 6.4 over the Eagles in week 8.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore is 4-2 but ranked #21, and a 13-10 loss at Cleveland did not help. Tyler Huntley's start puts them 3.7 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets move up 2 spots to #22 despite a 26-19 loss to the Patriots. The offense is -2.0 points, but the Dolphins visit next and the model has New York favored by 5.1.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona jumps 4 spots to #23 after an 18-16 win over the Rams. The point differential is still -52, and the Broncos visit next as 2.2-point favorites.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas has lost 3 straight, the latest a 33-30 home loss to the Bills. The offense is -1.6 points, and the Rams visit next with the Raiders as 5.7-point underdogs.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans climbs a spot to #25 after a 34-27 win over the Giants. Next is a neutral-field game against the Steelers, where the model has them as underdogs by 3.1.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants slip to #26 after a 34-27 home loss to the Saints. They are 3-2-1, and the model has them as 7.4-point underdogs at Houston.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay drops 5 spots to #27 after a 26-19 home loss to the Steelers. They are 1-5, and Jalon Daniels starting puts them 3.1 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-6 and have lost 6 straight, the latest a 22-6 loss at Kansas City. The offense is -3.0 points, and the Rams are a 10.8-point problem in week 8.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland is 4-2 after a 13-10 win over the Ravens, yet ranked #29 with a -16 point differential. The offense is -3.0 points. Next is a trip to Tennessee.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia has lost 4 straight, the latest a 25-14 home loss to the Panthers. Tanner McKee starting puts them 4.2 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami is 0-5 and lost 5 straight before the bye week. The offense is -2.4 points, and the Jets are next with the Dolphins as 5.1-point underdogs.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee stays at #32 even after a 26-20 win over the Colts. Their rating rose 1.7 points, but the offense is still -3.0 points. The Browns visit next.
